name: Elliptical Trainer

instructions.description: Step onto the stationary pedals while holding the rails.
Begin moving slowly and establish balance.
Use a smooth stride with an upright trunk.
Reduce resistance and speed before stepping off.

performanceMetrics.notes: Record the time performed with comfortable, controlled technique.
Record average movement or step cadence.
Record the individual's perceived effort after the exercise.

variations.variationDescription: Elliptical Trainer — Interval Progression: Alternate manageable work and recovery periods while keeping the same activity.

commentsNotes: Begin with low resistance and use the handrails for entry and exit.
